description: This Java class 'CreateTransactionLoanCommandStrategy' implements the CommandStrategy interface. It handles creating a loan transaction by parsing the request URL to extract the loan ID and command, and then delegates to the LoanTransactionsApiResource to execute the transaction. It constructs the BatchResponse with appropriate status and body based on the execution outcome.

classes.name: CreateTransactionLoanCommandStrategy
classes.description: Implements command handling for creating loans transactions, parsing URL for loan ID and command, calling the LoanTransactionsApiResource, and constructing BatchResponse.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Processes the BatchRequest to create a loan transaction, extracts parameters from URL, invokes the loan transaction API, and returns the BatchResponse with status and result.
